content.short: Ayzd aggregates the best sources of NFT news and presents them in a convenient way for users.
content.description: Since its launch in 2021, Ayzd has stood as a comprehensive resource for NFT news and data. Users can explore the NFT project database, access a live news feed, and browse top collections. The platform offers robust analytics and statistics to help assess market activity, a valuation guide to estimate worth, and the ability to see which projects are currently popular. Developers can also access the latest NFT news to stay informed about industry developments.
